Question 12
?

Find the first three non-zero terms of the Maclaurin expansion of ln⁡(2−x).

a
ln⁡(2−x)=ln⁡2−2x−4x2−⋯
b
ln⁡(2−x)=ln⁡2−x2−x216−⋯
c
ln⁡(2−x)=ln⁡2−x−x28−⋯
d
ln⁡(2−x)=ln⁡2−x−4x2−⋯
e
ln⁡(2−x)=ln⁡2−x2−x28−⋯
